name: seller-sdk-workspace
description: Рабочее пространство типобезопасных SDK для API маркетплейсов.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @seller-sdk/ozon build && pnpm --filter @seller-sdk/wb build && pnpm --filter @seller-sdk/ym build && pnpm --filter seller-sdk build
scripts.format: prettier --write "packages/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "test-d/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs" package.json "packages/*/package.json" tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.type-tests.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "test-d/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs" package.json "packages/*/package.json" tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.type-tests.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:endpoints && pnpm check:domains && pnpm check:values && pnpm check:request-docs && pnpm check:wb && pnpm check:ym && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:check: pnpm check:release && pnpm verify && pnpm pack:check && pnpm test:consumer
